# Sales Intelligence System — Plan Request

## Goal

Develop a plan for a Sales Intelligence System that helps sales staff adapt a gold-standard guide to individual leads.

## How It Works

- The sales rep feeds the transcript of a conversation with the customer into an AI agent.
- The AI agent merges that transcript with the gold-standard script.

## System Requirements

- Continuously improve a gold-standard script that works generally and is proven.
- Provide agent prompt templates that fill in the gold-standard script using an individual spoken transcript containing information about a specific customer.
